name: Essential Addons for WooCommerce
author: CodeConfig

sections.description:
Essential Addons for WooCommerce is an all-in-one toolkit to enhance your WooCommerce store. From advanced cart functionalities to sleek product presentation and checkout customizations, this plugin adds features that improve user experience and boost conversions.

👁️ See More Feature | 🚀 Get PRO

🎯 Key Features:

  • 🛒 Manage Add to Cart Button: Customize button behavior and appearance.
  • 🛍️ One Page Checkout: Boost your sales to give easy checkout solutions via WooCommerce solutions.
  • ䷧ Customizer Supported: Quick view, Wishlist, custom quantity etc preview are available in the WordPress Customizer.
  • 📱 Manage Product Variations: Completely manageable product variation from the plugin Dashboard and have so many customizations.
  • 📌 Sticky Cart & Product Info: Keep cart actions and product details visible while scrolling.
  • 🧾 Sidebar Cart Manager with Checkout: Let users complete their purchase directly from the sidebar cart.
  • 🧺 Mini Cart with Customizer Options: Show cart content in a stylish popup with customizable designs.
  • ➕ Custom Quantity Selectors : Use Custom quantity fields for better usability from pre-built design with custom colors.
  • 👀 Recently Viewed Products : Display products the customer recently visited in the Product details page.
  • 🔍 Quick View : Let users preview product details in a popup without leaving the page.
  • 💾 Cart Save & Share : Save current cart and share via link or email so on.
  • 💸 Discount Rules : Apply flexible pricing rules and promotions.
  • 🎨 WooCommerce Tab Customization : Rename, remove, or reorder tabs on product pages.
  • 🎞️ Product Gallery Slider : Show products in a responsive carousel anywhere on your site.
  • 💖 Wishlist : Let users save products for later from their own accounts.
  • 💱 Currency Converter : Let users view prices in different currencies.
  • ⚡ Ajax Search : Coming soon
  • 🎚️ Advanced Filters : Coming soon

Perfect for store owners looking to deliver a seamless, engaging shopping experience that converts.

sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin .zip file.
  2. Upload it to /wp-content/plugins/essential-addons-for-woocommerce/ or install via the WordPress admin panel.
  3. Activate the plugin via the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  4. Go to WooCommerce > Essential Addons to configure your settings.
sections.faq:
Does this work with any WooCommerce theme?

Yes, it’s built to integrate smoothly with any WooCommerce-compatible theme.

Will this affect my website’s performance?

No. The plugin is performance-optimized and loads only essential scripts when needed.

Are all features available in the free version?

Several features are available in the free version, while Pro unlocks more advanced functionalities.

Can I customize styles and behavior?

Yes. Many features come with Customizer or settings panel options.

Is work with Astra, Hello Elementor etc themes

Yes, it’s built to integrate smoothly with the popular theme.
